intent: To provide buyer with the invoice and associated business reason to initiate processing without presuming any approval status.
payload_summary: Sent invoice and business reason details to buyer for review as per normal procedure.
preconditions_claimed: Invoice and business reason are present
expected_effect: Buyer receives necessary documentation to begin processing payment without any assumption of approval.
risk_flags: No explicit approval present; processing may be delayed or blocked if not approved

intent: Encourage timely payment by emphasizing near-term urgency.
payload_summary: Communicate that prompt payment is needed to meet upcoming internal deadlines and avoid processing delays.
preconditions_claimed: Invoice and business reason are present
Requester has sent invoice and business reason details to buyer
expected_effect: Buyer understands urgency and prioritizes payment processing to meet deadlines.

intent: Obtain explicit payment approval from the approver before proceeding with payment processing.
payload_summary: Request explicit approval for payment of invoice with attached business rationale; no prior explicit approval found.
preconditions_claimed: Invoice and business reason are present
expected_effect: The approver will provide explicit payment approval or rejection, clarifying approval status.
risk_flags: Proceeding without explicit approval risks policy non-compliance
Deadline and vendor pressure do not constitute approval evidence

intent: Request additional information to ensure informed approval decision
payload_summary: Request buyer to provide further evidence supporting the invoice payment beyond initial invoice and business reason
preconditions_claimed: Requester and vendor pressures not sufficient for approval
expected_effect: Buyer will provide additional supporting evidence or justification before approval or rejection
risk_flags: Approval made without sufficient evidence risk
Potential payment error or fraud risk

intent: Request additional evidence to resolve approval ambiguity before handing payment off to accounting.
payload_summary: Ask requester to provide further evidence or clarification since explicit approval is absent and approver requested more evidence.
expected_effect: Obtain missing approval evidence to enable accurate payment processing and reduce risk of incorrect payment action.
risk_flags: Pressure from vendor not formal approval

intent: Hold the payment to prevent processing without explicit approval evidence, as approval remains unresolved and more evidence has been requested.
payload_summary: Hold payment due to absence of explicit approval and ongoing requests for more evidence from buyer and approver.
preconditions_claimed: Buyer accounting handoff requested more evidence
expected_effect: Payment process is paused to avoid unauthorized payments until explicit approval evidence is provided.
risk_flags: Risk of vendor dissatisfaction due to hold
